summary.text: Mike Chaisson is a Republican state representative from the 1st Bristol District who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Mike Chaisson's career experience includes owning and operating Chaiss Construction and serving on the Foxborough Advisory Board, according to Ballotpedia.
He won the open 1st Bristol District seat in the November 5, 2024 general election, defeating Democrat Kostas Loukos 49.6% to 47.2%, and succeeded F. Jay Barrows.

For 2025-2026 Chaisson was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and to several joint committees, including serving as ranking minority member of the Municipalities and Regional Government Joint Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.
